PDF Watermark Text

Stamp a text watermark on every page of a PDF: your text, opacity, rotation, size and color — done in your browser with PDF-Lib.

PDF Watermark Text

Stamp a text watermark diagonally across every page.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PDF.
  2. Type the watermark text (e.g. DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL).
  3. Set opacity, rotation, size and color.
  4. Click "Add Watermark & Download".

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the watermark permanent?

The watermark is drawn into the page content itself, so it survives copying, printing and conversion.

Can I use a diagonal watermark?

Yes — rotate it anywhere from 0° to 90°, and the preview math places it centered on each page regardless of page size.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

Everything runs locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Files are never uploaded to any server.
